scope: Input preflight for the completed 128-person public experiment. Checks workload counts and source fingerprints against the completed run; no new 128-person scoring or outcome validation.

dimensions.count_overflow_behavior: Counts that exceed u64 are null, never wrapped or truncated.

limitations: Preflight validates the manifest, sample alignment, model payloads, extraction/reference identities and BED syntax. It performs no genotype-to-score scan.
Cohort and frequency data blocks are decoded lazily by scoring; preflight does not validate every block or prove that scoring will succeed. Some older single-sample formats decode during opening.
Common-callable terms, baseline coverage, missingness, model eligibility and score distributions are unknown until scoring. No score, percentile or clinical validity is established.

Candidate term/sample/scenario cells are a structural upper bound before exclusions, not an operation count, runtime estimate, RAM estimate or output byte estimate. Baseline/reference work adds further processing.
Input fingerprints identify file bytes. Inputs must remain immutable during preparation and scoring.
Preflight is a separate check, not a reusable approval or resume checkpoint. Run the original manifest again into a new output directory to score it.
observations: Model "PGS000018" has inconsistent declared and actual inventories; inspect its provenance before interpreting scores.
Frequency-source independence is a user declaration. Input checks cannot establish independence from the evaluation participants.

pilot_regression.scope: Preparation refactor regression on the full public model with eight targets and fourteen scenarios; numerical parity only, not a new genotype oracle or timing benchmark.

pilot_build_note: Pilot regression used the same preparation/scoring implementation before preflight-only explanatory text and zero-dimension overflow handling edits. Binary identities are retained separately.
